A01.title: ABI Descriptions, Layout Probes, and Version Reads
A01.boundary_and_ownership: One canonical fixed-layout C ABI description, independent of SQL/HTTP/GPU. Rust/C/C# records and status/storage widths must agree.
A01.native_reuse: Rust repr(C), C fixed-width declarations, .NET Sequential structs/LibraryImport; no Rust native ABI.
A01.csharp_surface: Internal blittable ABI records and engine-prefixed get_abi_v1 bootstrap; application code sees no raw pointers.
implementation_steps: Implement D02 complete wire records, defined reserved fields, size/capacity negotiation and engine-prefixed symbols from one versioned description.
Generate sizeof/alignof/every-offset probes for C and Rust plus C# SizeOf/OffsetOf; archive actual output and compiler target.
Implement only scalar status plus out-pointer returns; document null/alias/alignment/borrow/output initialization for every export.
Bind layout/symbol inventory to source and ABI version; keep examples/goldens distinct from implementation-generated output.
Public API refinement 0.4.0: Internal fixed-layout C ABI, generated layouts and bootstrap descriptions; expose no raw handles or pointers to application code.

A03.title: Synchronous Handles and Resource Leases
A03.boundary_and_ownership: Logical admission gate plus physical native resource lease; SafeHandle alone is not the admission policy.
A03.native_reuse: Rust RAII owners/Arc as source semantics permit; creating module releases its own resources.
A03.csharp_surface: Private SafeHandle owner; TryAcquire/lease and Dispose/DisposeAsync with explicit lifecycle.
implementation_steps: Implement Open→Closing→Closed admission under one synchronization policy; acquire logical token and DangerousAddRef before exposing native pointer.
Roll back all earlier increments if a later acquisition fails; close admission atomically and let previously admitted calls finish.
Release physical lease and logical token exactly once in finally/RAII, including managed mapping/native errors.
Expose completion of true retirement separately from synchronous Dispose request; finalizer path must be bounded/nonblocking.
Public API refinement 0.4.0: Internal SafeHandle/resource admission and parent-child leases underpin every public owner; no public copyable owning struct.

Public API refinement 0.4.0: Use api_design_inputs and api_design_input_sha256 from the exact pinned Design commit; implement the declared member/type policies and native operation mapping. For internal-only scopes document applicability and expose no accidental public plumbing.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: No new admission succeeds after close linearization; a call holding an earlier admitted lease may enter/finish native code during Closing. No native release before every admitted lease ends.
Double Dispose is idempotent but arbitrary double native release is a caller defect; avoid false reuse of recycled pointer identity.
specific_acceptance: Deterministic barriers cover each named acquire/close/AddRef boundary schedule under recorded operation/thread/preemption bounds and verify actual native live/release counters.
Late GC/finalizer with in-flight call, allocation failure between acquisitions and mapper exception leave no leaked owner.

A04.title: Owned Buffers and Async Leases
A04.boundary_and_ownership: Owned/borrowed byte regions and retained async leases; no allocator identity guessing.
A04.native_reuse: Rust Vec/Bytes owners and source-verified destruction; D07 complete extent/stride contract.
A04.csharp_surface: CopyTo/ToArray and synchronous nonescaping scoped byte views under an active owner lease; async input uses bounded native copy or an explicitly accepted retained-owner/pin profile.
implementation_steps: Implement D07 contiguous byte-view length/count/element-width and offset checks, checked u64↔nuint conversion, isize::MAX and allocation-capacity bounds; preserve null+zero rules. A strided view requires a separately accepted profile and is not part of v1.
Attach owner/type/release function to every allocation; copy/pin/borrow is an explicit profile with a defined end.
Hold owner and budget through clones/slices/async delivery; retain full backing allocation charge rather than visible slice length.
Dispose/pin release occurs after the last admitted consumer; mapper/conversion errors release all unpublished outputs.
Public API refinement 0.4.0: NativeBuffer, NativeBufferReader and maintainer NativeBufferFactory; scoped reads, explicit copies, async staging and release.

error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Never create Span from untrusted extent before validation; no CLR free of Rust memory or cross-CRT ownership.
Cancel/timeout/Body EOF does not revoke another live buffer lease.

The initial public surface is CopyTo/ToArray or a synchronous nonescaping scoped view with an active lease; do not expose arbitrary native-backed Memory/MemoryManager or a Span after dropping its owner lease.

Retained slices, copy overlap, malformed descriptor, GC/Dispose races and creating-module release count on each OS AOT.

A05.title: Controlled Error and Panic Conversion Boundaries
A05.boundary_and_ownership: Single status/ErrorRecord/panic containment authority for every adapter.
A05.native_reuse: Rust catch_unwind only for unwind-mode panic and nonpanicking native cleanup; no invented process-fault recovery.
A05.csharp_surface: Typed managed exception/result translation outside ABI callbacks; bounded native detail record.
implementation_steps: Implement D08 exact status constants, complete ErrorRecord capacity algorithm and bounded UTF8 detail ownership.
Initialize every valid out-owner slot before fallible work; on error destroy unpublished state and translate without callbacks/reentrancy.

Contain exported Rust panics; handle caught payload destruction risk and poison the owning Engine after every contained native panic under D08; permit only explicitly trusted cleanup and never resume normal admission.
Catch managed Handler exceptions inside valid UCO entrypoints and preserve committed operation outcome; diagnostics cannot overwrite terminal results.
Public API refinement 0.4.0: NativeEngineException, EngineLoadException and EngineLoadFailure; preserve native diagnostics and represent absent pre-native fields honestly.
